goal:
Repair this disposable static conference operations dashboard for a fixed 1280×720 viewport. Preserve all supplied visible text and figures, including all eight sessions, full session titles, speaker names, times, rooms and tracks. The finished page should have a shared header/title, aligned overview statistic cards, a readable dense schedule, a coherent registration summary and a visible status footer. All content must be legible without horizontal or vertical scrolling, clipping or overlap, with consistent spacing and a clear visual hierarchy. Keep text at least 12px (table headers may be 11px). Static HTML/CSS only, no scripts, network or external assets. Use screenshots to decide what needs correction and verify the whole page when useful. You may finish when satisfied; there is no required number of edits or images.
Start by saving the supplied starter verbatim to index.html with official write, then render and inspect it before making layout corrections. Use only official write/edit/read for index.html. Use one tool per response; never edit and render in the same response. For rendering call bash with exactly: /tmp/ds41f-phase2-renderer/bin/python /Volumes/SDXC-512/ds41f-mlx/tools/phase3_render_handoff.py request. Use the session workspace as workdir, no background execution or escalation. Then call official read_image on the returned screenshot pathname; rendering alone does not show you the image. At most seven renders AND seven image observations are available; do not request more. Do not retry uncertain tool effects or failed renders. Work only in index.html.
